state.title: fix(security): update grpc past GO-2026-6348
state.body:
## Problem

The repository-wide `govulncheck` gate began failing on otherwise unrelated PRs, including #6385, because `google.golang.org/grpc@v1.83.0` reaches GO-2026-6348. The advisory fixes that reachable HTTP/2 fragmentation OOM in v1.83.1. A second imported-package advisory, CVE-2026-84445 / GO-2026-6443, requires v1.83.2 on the 1.83 line.

## Fix

- raise the Gas City module from grpc v1.83.0 to v1.83.2;
- raise the agent image's source-built `bd` override to the same security floor;
- remove the now-obsolete `bd` and `gc` paths from both grpc Trivy waivers while retaining the still-vulnerable `gh` and `dolt` paths;
- update the existing security-policy tests so the module, container build, and waiver set remain locked together.

No application code changes.

## Verification

- RED: the same `govulncheck v1.7.0` invocation reported one reachable vulnerability, GO-2026-6348, on grpc v1.83.0.
- GREEN: `go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 -show verbose ./...` reports zero reachable or imported-package vulnerabilities on v1.83.2.
- `go mod verify`
- `go test -count=1 ./scripts`
- `go test -count=1 ./internal/warmup ./internal/events ./internal/runtime/t3bridge`
- `go vet ./...`
- repository pre-commit hook passed (lint, generated references, vet).

This is intentionally separate from #6385 so that reaper fix remains a two-file, single-purpose patch.
